extensionDescription.message: Warns about non-ASCII domain characters that resemble ASCII letters. Checks locally using Unicode data.

warningBody.message: This address contains characters that resemble English letters, or an invalid Punycode label. Verify the address before entering passwords or payment details.

clearBody.message: No characters matched this extension’s policy. This does not establish that the site is safe.

unsupportedBody.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS page, then open this extension again. Allow website access in Safari to receive automatic warnings.

errorBody.message: The address or detection data could not be read. Check this extension’s website permissions in Safari and reload the page.

policyNote.message: Unicode 17.0.0 · Checked on this device · No browsing data saved

warningLimit.message: Warning only: this extension does not block connections. The page may already have loaded. A website can hide the page banner; check the Safari toolbar popup for an independent result.
